sections.description:
Definition

ORDINANCE X OF 1977
ORDINANCE X OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN
BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE 1977

2.
Definition. In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the
following expression, shall have the meaning hereby respectively assigned to
theme that is to say:-
(a)
"Board" means the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
constituted under, motion 6 of this Ordinance;
(b)
"'Chairman" means the Chairman of the Board;
(c)
"College" meant an Institution within the jurisdiction of the Board
and recognised by it for Intermediate Education, and includes a college having
intermediate and Degree clue and stated to the University of Baluchistan for
the Degree classes ;
(d)
''Committee" means a committee constituted under this Ordinance ;
(e)
"Controller of Examination" means the Controller of Examinations of
the Board ;
(f)
"Controlling Authority" means the Controlling Authority specified in
section 12 of this Ordinance ;
(g)
"Government" meant the Government of Baluchistan;
(h)
"Head of an Institution'' mesas the Principal of a College or the
Headmaster or Headmistress of a school ;
(i)
"Institution'" mom a college or a school ;
(j)
"Intermediate College" means an institution recognised for imparting
instruction to Class XI and Class, XII, and includes an institution having
classes for Intermediate and Secondary Education;
(k)
"Intermediate Education" means education pertaining to Class XI and
XII ;
(l)
"University" means the University of Baluchistan ;
(m)
"Quetta Board" mans the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
Quetta ;
(n)
'"Prescribed" means prescribed by regulations or rules ;
(o)
"Principal" means the Head of a College ;
(p)
"Recognised" means recognised by the Board ;
(q)
"School"' means an Institution within the jurisdiction of the Board
and recognised by it only for Secondary Education ;
(r)
"Regulation' and Rules" means respectively the regulation and rules
made under this Ordinance ;
(s)
"Secondary Education" means Education pertaining to Class IX and
Class X and such other classes as may be declared by Government to be classes
of Secondary Education ;
(t)
"Secretary" means the Secretary of the Board;
(u)
"Schedule" means the Schedule appended to the Ordinance;

Constitution of the Board

ORDINANCE X OF 1977

6.
Constitution of the Board. The Board shall consist of the following
members, namely :-
(1) (i)
Chairman.
(ii) A
University Professor nominated by the vice Chancellor of the Unity of
Baluchistan.
(iii)
The Director of Education in Baluchistan.
(iv)
The Principal, Government Polytechnic Institute, Quetta.
(v) One
representative of the syndicate of the University.
(vi)
One Principal of a College nominated by the Controlling Authority.
(vii)
One representative of Heads of Intermediate Colleges to be elected by the
Principals from amongst themselves.
(viii)
One representative of the Headmaster/Headmistress to be elected by the
Headmasters/Headmistresses from amongst themselves.
(ix)
Two persons nominated by the Controlling Authority.
(2) The
names of the nominated members shall be notified in the official Gazette.
(3) The
term of Am of members other than the as officio members shall be two years.
(4) No
member appointed by virtue of his office shall continue to be a member of any
of the committee, of which he may be member.
(5)
When a person ceases to be a member of a Board, he shall cease to be member of
any of the committee' of which he may be a member.

sections.description:
Powers of the Board

ORDINANCE X OF 1977
ORDINANCE X OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN
BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE 1977
An
Ordinance to establish Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan at Quetta
[Gazette
of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 7th November 1977]
No.
Legis 1-34/Law/75.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Baluchistan on the 7th November 1977, is hereby published for general
information :-
11.
Powers of the Board.---(1) Subject to the provision, of this Ordinance the
Boned shall have powers to organise, regulate, develop and control Intermediate
Education sad Secondary Education.
(2) In
particular and without prejudice to the generality of the powers conferred by
the Preceding subsection the Board shall have powers :-
(i) to
hold and conduct all examinations pertaining to Intermediate Education
Secondary Education Pakistan and classical language and such other examinations
as may be determined by Government.
(ii) to
prescribe courses of study for its examination;
(iii)
to lay down conditions for recognition of institutions.
(iv) to
accord refuse or withdraw recognition, wholly or partly.-
(a) is
case of schools maintained by the Government of Pakistan after considering
inspection reports from the Officer appointed for the purpose by the Director
of Education.
(b) in
the care of other aohooid6 after considering inspection reports from the
inspection Committee appointed bar the Board for the purpose.
(c) in
the caw of Intermediate Colleges after considering reports from an inspection
committee appointed by the Board in this behalf.
(v) to
inspect and arrange for Inspection of recognised institutions and call for
inspection report in respect of such Institutions other than the institu tions
run by the Government of Pakistan.
(vi) to
lay down conditions for admission to its examinations, to determine the
eligibility of candidates and to admit them to such examinations ;
(vii)
to grant certificates and diplomas to parsons who have passed its examinations
and to withdraw such certificates and diplomas ;
(viii)
to fix, demand and receive such few as may be prescribed ;
(ix) to
supervise the residence health and discipline of the students of recognised
institutions with a view to promoting their general welfare ;
(x) to
institute and award scholarships, medals and prince in accordance with the
regulations and rules
(xi) to
organise and promote extra-moral activities in and for reed institutions;
(xii)
to hold control and administer its property and fund ;
(xiii)
to enter into and carry out contracts in exercise of its power and in the
performance of its duties cadet this ordinance and the regulations;
(xiv)
to pass its annual budget ;
(xv) to
transfer any movable and immovable property belong to it ;
(xvi)
to hold and manage endowments ;
(xvii)
to regulate and decide all administrative matters including the creation and
abolition of posts under the Board with the prior approval of the Controlling
Authority ;
(xviii)
to appoint such officers and staff as it may consider necessary for the
performance of the functions and define their duties and Conditions of service;
(xix)
to make provision for buildings, premises, furniture apparatus books and other
means required for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance ;
(xx) to
sanction or incur such expenditure ad may be necessary for carrying out the
purposes of this Ordinance, and
(xxi)
to do all other acts necessary for carrying out the purposed of this Ordinance.
(3) The
Board may delegate any of its powers to ltd Chairman or any officer of the
Board or to a committee or sub-committee appointed by et, so it may deem fit.

Power of the Controlling Authority

ORDINANCE X OF 1977
ORDINANCE X OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN
BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE 1977
An
Ordinance to establish Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan at Quetta
[Gazette
of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 7th November 1977]

Baluchistan on the 7th November 1977, is hereby published for general
information :-
13.
Power of the Controlling Authority. The Controlling Authority shall have
the power to cause and inspection to be made, by such person or persons as it
may direct of the offices activities and funds of, and to cause any enquiry to
be made in like manner in respect of any matter concerning the Board.
(2) The
Controlling Authority shall communicate to the Board the results of such
inspection of enquiry and may advise the Board to take such action and within
such period as may be specified.
(3) The
Board shall report to the Controlling Authority the action it proposes to take
or has taken on such communication.
(4)
Where the Board does not within a reasonable time take action to the
satisfaction of the Controlling Authority, the Controlling Authority may after
considering any explanation made by the Board, issue such directions as it
thinks fit, and the Chairman shall comply with such directions.
(5) If
the Controlling Authority is satisfied that any proceeding of the Board or a
committee is not in conformity with this Ordinance the Con trolling Authority
may, without prejudice to the foregoing provisions of this section, by order in
writing annul such proceedings:
Provided
that before making any such order, the Controlling Authority shall, through the
Chairman, call upon the Board or the Committee, as the case may be to show
cause as to why such an order should not be made
(6) The
Controlling Authority may, from time to limo, direct the Board to conduct its
affairs and to perform its functions in such manner ear may be specified.
(7) The
Controlling Authority may, require the Board to furnish it with :-
(i) any
return, statement, estimate, statistics or other Information regarding any
matter under the control of the Boards or
(ii) a
report on any such matter ; or
(iii) a
copy of any document in the charge of the Board and the Chairman shall comply with
every std requisition.

ORDINANCE X OF 1977
ORDINANCE X OF 1977

15.
Chairman.--(1) The Chairman shall be a whole-time officer and shall be
appointed by the Controlling Authority on such terms and conditions as may be
determined by the Controlling Authority.
(2) The
Chairman shall hold office for a term of three years from the date of
notification of his appointment and on the expiry of the term of office shall
be eligible for appointment for such further period not exceeding three years,
as may be specified in the order of re-appointment;
Provided
that the Controlling Authority may, at any time review the work of the Chairman
and if on such review it is satisfied that in the interest of the Board, or for
any other sufficient cause, it is necessary to do so, it may, after giving the
Chairman an opportunity of showing cause against the proposed action, reduce
the term of office of the Chairman to such period to it way determine.
(3) If
at any time the office of the Chairman is vacant temporarily or otherwise, by
reason of leave, illness or other cause, for a period not exceed ing one year,
the Controlling Authority shall take such arrangements for carrying out the duties
of the office of the Chairman as it may thick fit.
(4) The
Chairman shall be the principal executive and academic officers of the Board
and shall, when present, preside at the meetings of.
(i) The
Board.
(ii)
The Committees of the Board constituted under section 18.
(5) It
shall be the duty of the Chairman to ensure that the provisions of this
Ordinance and the regulations sad rules are faithfully observed and caused out,
and be shall exercise all powers necessary for dais purpose.
(6) The
Chairman may create a temporary post under the Board for a period not exceeding
six months.
(7) In
any emergency arising out of the Administrative business of the Board and
requiring in the opinion of the Chairman, immediate actions the Chairman may
take such action at he may doom necessary and shall report the action taken to
the Board at its next meeting for approval.
(8) The
Chairman shall exercise such other powers as may be prescribed by regulations.

1.
Power and duties of Chairman.---The Chairman shall exercise control over
the office of the Board as its principal executive academic officer and shall
do all acts to ensure that the officers and the staff properly perform the
duties entrusted thence.
(i)
write confidential reports on the work of officers whose grades carry an

2.

the control of the Chairman, be incharge of the academic and administrative,
sector of the Board's Office, and cause the orders and decisions of the board
and the Chairman to be carried out.
(2) The
Secretary shall take all possible steps to ensure that the funds of the Board
are spent on the purpose for which they are provided.
(3) The
Secretary shall cause to prepared and submit to the Board for approval the
annual statements of accounts and budget estimate.
(4) All
meetings of the Board and the Committees shall be convened by the secretary
under the directions of the Chairman. While preparing the agenda for a meeting
of the Board or a committee the Secretary shall carry out the directions of the
Chairman given in this respect and no items shall be pled on such agenda or be
considered in the tinting without previous permission of the Chairman.
(5) The
Secretary shall record the minutes and maintain the records of the proceeding
of the Board.
(6) The
Secretary shall conduct tie official correspondence of the Board under the
authority of the Chairman except the corresponds relating to the conduct of the
Examinations.
(7) All
fees and dove payable to the Board and all rums received by the Secretary,
shall be credited without delay to the account of the Board, in a bank approved
by the Board.
(8) The
Secretary shall issue to successful candidates on behalf of the Board in the
prescribed form certificates of having passed the Examinations held by the
Board.
(9) The
Secretary shall perform such other duties a way be assigned to him by the
Chairman.
(10)
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in these regulations, the
Board may assn to any other officer or officers such duties of the Secretary as
it may deem necessary.
(11)
The post of the Secretary shall be a tenure post. The term of his appointment
shall be three years and may be renewed.
